company.description: Degla develops software for coordinating autonomous drone fleets. Its platform converts natural-language objectives into multi-drone mission plans, assigns aircraft, defines coverage, and adapts operations to changing conditions. The system supports search and rescue, emergency response, infrastructure inspection, and other critical field operations. It enables teams to supervise mission objectives while the software manages flight coordination and real-time rerouting.
